_note: YPDS Jakarta 2026 — Official Event Rundown & Schedule (Aug 20–23, 2026), single source of truth per CSCD's official rundown document. Subject to slight changes as per agenda changes during the forum.

days.label: August 20, 2026
days.title: Arrival & Networking
days.description: Delegates arrive and check into Artotel Jakarta; the summit opens with a welcome reception and dinner at Tugu Kunstkring Paleis.

items.title: Hotel Check-in
items.description: Delegates arrive and complete registration at Artotel Jakarta throughout the day. Standard check-in is from 3:00 PM; early check-in around 1:00 PM may be available subject to room availability — if your room isn't ready yet, you're welcome to wait in the lobby.

items.title: Welcome Reception
items.description: Informal gathering for delegates to meet fellow practitioners and cultural diplomats in an open, reflective environment enabling initial conversations and network formation.

items.title: Welcome Dinner
items.description: Curated dinner experience introducing delegates to Jakarta's cultural atmosphere and diplomatic community. Focus on connection, shared diplomatic journeys, and cross-cultural dialogue.

days.label: August 21, 2026
days.title: Institutional Engagement & Strategic Context
days.description: A full day of institutional visits — ASEAN Headquarters, Indonesia's Ministry of Culture, and (tentatively) the Embassy of Pakistan — examining regional cooperation and cultural diplomacy frameworks.

items.title: ASEAN Headquarters
items.description: Strategic engagement with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations examining institutional framework, regional cooperation mechanisms, and cultural diplomacy's role in advancing integration. Sets the intellectual ground for the summit. Departure from Artotel Jakarta at 8:30 AM.

items.title: Ministry of Culture
items.description: Exclusive engagement examining government cultural preservation initiatives, artistic development support, and international cultural diplomacy frameworks, exploring policy linkages between culture and diplomatic objectives.

items.title: Embassy of Pakistan (Tentative)
items.description: Diplomatic engagement with Pakistani embassy officials examining bilateral cultural cooperation, public diplomacy practice, and South-South cultural exchanges. Subject to diplomatic confirmation.

days.label: August 22, 2026
days.title: Policy Dialogue & Strategic Analysis
days.description: Morning policy sessions at Artotel Jakarta followed by an immersive institutional visit to Gudskul, an independent creative and research institute.

items.title: Policy Sessions
items.description: Comprehensive program including panel discussions on cultural diplomacy frameworks, policy debates on art's role in peacebuilding, interactive dialogues on youth leadership in international cooperation, and strategic analysis of how cultural practice informs diplomatic strategy.

items.title: Gudskul Institutional Visit & Sessions
items.description: Immersive experience at Gudskul, an innovative creative and research institute, combining institutional engagement with continued policy discussions. Examines how independent cultural institutions contribute to public diplomacy, community engagement, and artistic innovation. Departure from Artotel Jakarta at 2:00 PM.

days.label: August 23, 2026
days.title: Farewell and Closure
days.description: A final breakfast together before delegates check out and depart, closing the forum.

items.title: Farewell Breakfast
items.description: Final breakfast bringing delegates together for reflection and informal discussion.

items.title: Hotel Checkout
items.description: Delegates complete checkout and depart. Forum concludes.
